title: The Missing Half of the Recipe (रेसिपी का गायब आधा हिस्सा)

scenes.title: रूम नंबर चार की दो बार घंटी
scenes.summary: Room 4's desk buzzer gives its signature double ring, and F3 brings the old green cloth botanical book downstairs to inspect with F1 and M1.

scenes.title: पुदीने के पत्तों के बीच
scenes.summary: In Room 9, F3 lifts the missing bottom half of the berry-and-almond cake recipe from between pressed mint leaves, though an old raindrop blurred the final line.

scenes.title: तीन छोटे बेकिंग टिन
scenes.summary: In the café kitchen, F2 puts aprons on M4 and F1 to bake three small test cakes with three different glazes.

scenes.title: बैच एक बहुत खट्टा है
scenes.summary: After M2 measures the lemon glaze for Batch One without his reading glasses, M1 takes one bite and declares it sour enough to polish brass.

scenes.title: बैच टू की ज़ोरदार कड़क
scenes.summary: M4 unveils Batch Two with a heavy toasted sugar top so hard that his brother M3 jokes he could use it to tile a courtyard roof.

scenes.title: दबे हुए पन्ने को सूंघना
scenes.summary: Holding the smudged recipe card up to the Room 9 window light with F3, F2 spots a tiny orange-blossom sketch and smells wildflower honey and sweet orange peel.

scenes.title: पेंसिल से दस में से दस
scenes.summary: F2 serves Tin Three brushed with warm honey and orange zest; M1 eats in silence, writes ten out of ten in his paper ledger, and asks for a second slice.

scenes.title: ऊपर वाली मंजिल पर लाल तारा
scenes.summary: Sharing cake in the courtyard, M3 compares the four-card puzzle map to the second-floor wooden balcony and spots an old brass lantern ring right where the red star points.
